mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_id, knowledge_name, knowledge_type, topic_id, knowledge_strategy, ext_config_json, visibility_scope, owner_id, is_exist, catalog_item_id, kb_code, space_id, tenant_id FROM bt_knowledge_base WHERE status_cd ='00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId}

SELECT knowledge_id, knowledge_name, knowledge_type, topic_id, knowledge_strategy, ext_config_json, visibility_scope, owner_id, is_exist, catalog_item_id, kb_code, space_id, tenant_id FROM bt_knowledge_base WHERE status_cd ='00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_id IN (#{knowledgeId})

SELECT a.document_id, a.doc_name, a.file_info_id, a.ext_system_id, b.document_id AS "dcDocumentId", b.library_id FROM bt_document a LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document b ON a.dc_document_id = b.document_id and a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and b.status_cd = '00A' WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
